name: How long does a typical single room renovation project take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical single room renovation project take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a single room renovation depends on its complexity and the room type. A small bathroom or bedroom renovation might take 3-6 weeks, while a more extensive kitchen renovation, involving custom elements or layout changes, could extend to 8-12 weeks. This timeframe includes design, material selection, demolition, construction, and final finishing. Unexpected issues or material delays can sometimes prolong the schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: A single room renovation generally takes 3-12 weeks, varying by room type and project complexity, with kitchens typically requiring more time.
